description: The file contains Python unit tests for the `envmapper` module, which handles parsing environment variable templates and mapping between common and framework-specific environment variable formats, specifically focusing on React in the test cases.

classes.name: TestTemplatePath
classes.description: Test cases for verifying template path retrieval for existing and non-existing frameworks.

classes.name: TestParseTemplateFile
classes.description: Tests for parsing environment template files with various contents and validity conditions.

classes.name: TestPrefixMapping
classes.description: Tests for the functionality that applies prefix mappings to environment variables.

classes.name: TestFrameworkMapping
classes.description: Tests for mapping environment variables from common to framework-specific format and vice versa.

classes.name: TestSupportedFrameworks
classes.description: Tests for retrieving supported frameworks and ensuring template files exist for each.

classes.name: TestUnmappedVariablePreservation
classes.description: Verifies that variables without explicit mappings are preserved during transformations.

classes.name: TestEdgeCases
classes.description: Contains tests for edge cases including special characters, unicode, very long values, and more.

classes.name: TestIntegration
classes.description: End-to-end tests covering the workflow from template parsing to variable mapping and back.

methods.name: test_get_template_path_existing(self)
methods.description: Verifies that the function correctly finds an existing template path for a known framework.

methods.name: test_get_template_path_nonexistent(self)
methods.description: Ensures that requesting a nonexistent framework raises a FileNotFoundError.

methods.name: test_parse_template_file_existing(self)
methods.description: Tests parsing a real existing template file and checks that prefix and mapping are correctly extracted.

methods.name: test_parse_template_file_nonexistent(self)
methods.description: Confirms that parsing a nonexistent template file raises FileNotFoundError.

methods.name: test_parse_template_file_with_prefix(self)
methods.description: Checks parsing a template YAML with a prefix and verifies correct extraction.

methods.name: test_parse_template_file_without_prefix(self)

methods.name: test_parse_template_file_empty(self)
methods.description: Verifies behavior when parsing an empty template file results in empty mapping.

methods.name: test_parse_template_file_invalid_yaml(self)
methods.description: Tests that invalid YAML content raises a ValueError indicating invalid YAML.

methods.name: test_parse_template_file_invalid_mapping(self)
methods.description: Ensures an error is raised if 'mapping' in YAML is not a dictionary.

methods.name: test_apply_prefix_mapping(self)
methods.description: Validates that the prefix is correctly applied to each environment variable key.

methods.name: test_apply_prefix_mapping_empty(self)
methods.description: Checks applying prefix to an empty environment returns an empty dict.

methods.name: test_map_common_to_framework_react(self)
methods.description: Tests mapping from common to React-specific environment variables, including direct and prefixed mappings.

methods.name: test_map_framework_to_common_react(self)
methods.description: Tests mapping from React environment variables back to a common format.

methods.name: test_mapping_roundtrip(self)
methods.description: Verifies that forward and reverse mappings preserve data integrity.

methods.name: test_mapping_with_empty_env(self)
methods.description: Checks that empty environment variables are handled gracefully.

methods.name: test_get_supported_frameworks(self)
methods.description: Ensures the function returns a list of supported frameworks, including 'react' and existing template paths.

methods.name: test_preserve_unmapped_common_variables(self)
methods.description: Ensures variables without explicit mappings are preserved during common-to-framework mapping.

methods.name: test_preserve_unmapped_framework_variables(self)
methods.description: Checks that variables without explicit mappings in framework-to-common mapping are preserved.

methods.name: test_mapping_with_special_characters(self)
methods.description: Verifies that special characters in environment variables are preserved after mappings.

methods.name: test_mapping_with_unicode(self)
methods.description: Ensures unicode characters are preserved through the mapping process.

methods.name: test_mapping_with_very_long_values(self)
methods.description: Tests handling of very long environment variable values, ensuring they are preserved accurately.

methods.name: test_full_workflow(self)
